terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.intro: These terms and conditions apply to all use of the cleaners platform (getcleaners.nl), operated by cleaners B.V., based in Amsterdam.

sections.title: Definitions
sections.body:
Platform: the website getcleaners.nl and related services.
Cleaner: the independent professional offering services via the Platform.
Client: the person booking a cleaner via the Platform.
Booking: the agreement between Client and Cleaner, facilitated by the Platform.

sections.title: Our service
sections.body: cleaners is a matchmaking platform. We are not a cleaning company and not a party to the agreement between Client and Cleaner. We facilitate contact, payment, and quality assurance.

sections.title: Bookings and payment
sections.body: Payment is processed via Stripe (iDEAL, credit card, or Apple Pay). The amount is held in escrow and only released after a successful clean. On top of the cleaner's hourly rate, we charge an 18% service fee covering verification, insurance, escrow, and customer support.

sections.title: Cancellation
sections.body: Clients may cancel free of charge up to 24 hours before the appointment. Late cancellations may be charged the full amount. Cleaners may cancel up to 48 hours in advance; repeated cancellations may result in account suspension.

sections.title: Cleaner verification
sections.body: Every cleaner goes through a verification process: identity check (passport + selfie), background check (VOG), and reference check. We do not guarantee that a cleaner meets all your expectations, but we ensure a thorough screening process.

sections.title: Insurance
sections.body: Every booking via the Platform is insured up to €300,000 for liability. The insurance covers property damage during the clean. Damage must be reported within 24 hours via our complaints form.

sections.title: Liability
sections.body: cleaners is not liable for the quality of cleaning services. Our liability is limited to the amount of the relevant booking. We make every effort to resolve disputes quickly and fairly through our complaints process.

sections.title: Intellectual property
sections.body: All content on the Platform (text, designs, logos, software) is the property of cleaners B.V. and may not be reproduced without written permission.

sections.title: Changes
sections.body: We reserve the right to modify these terms. Material changes will be communicated by email at least 14 days in advance. Continued use after the effective date constitutes acceptance.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: cleaners B.V. respects your privacy. This policy explains what personal data we collect, why, and how we protect it. This policy complies with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

sections.title: Data controller
sections.body:
cleaners B.V., based in Amsterdam, is the data controller for personal data processed via getcleaners.nl.
Email: privacy@getcleaners.nl

sections.title: What data we collect
sections.body:
Clients: name, email, address (for the clean), payment details (processed by Stripe — we never store card numbers).
Cleaners: name, email, phone, identity document, VOG, photo, bank details (for payout via Stripe Connect).
Website visitors: IP address, browser type, page visits (via functional cookies).

sections.title: Purpose of processing
sections.body:
We process data for:
• Executing bookings and payments
• Verifying cleaners (KYC)
• Improving our service
• Complying with legal obligations
• Handling complaints and disputes

sections.title: Legal basis
sections.body:
We process data based on:
• Performance of contract (booking)
• Legal obligation (tax, Wwft)
• Legitimate interest (fraud prevention, service improvement)
• Consent (marketing, where applicable)

sections.title: Retention period
sections.body: We retain personal data no longer than necessary. Booking data: 7 years (tax obligation). KYC documents: up to 5 years after account closure. Account data: until deletion by the user.

sections.title: Sharing with third parties
sections.body:
We share data with:
• Stripe (payment processing — US, EU model contract clauses)
• Supabase (database hosting — EU)
• Vercel (website hosting — EU/US, DPA)
We never sell personal data to third parties.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body: You have the right to access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability, and objection. Exercise your rights by emailing privacy@getcleaners.nl. We respond within 30 days.

sections.title: Security
sections.body: We take appropriate technical and organizational measures: encrypted connections (TLS), access control (Row Level Security), and regular security audits.

sections.title: Data Protection Authority
sections.body: If you have a complaint about our data processing, you can contact the Dutch Data Protection Authority (autoriteitpersoonsgegevens.nl).

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.intro: This page explains which cookies getcleaners.nl uses and why.

sections.title: What are cookies
sections.body: Cookies are small text files stored by your browser when you visit a website. They help the website remember your preferences and improve the service.

sections.title: Strictly necessary cookies
sections.body:
These cookies are essential for the website to function. Without them, you cannot log in or make a booking.

• sb-*: Supabase session cookies (authentication)
• __stripe_*: Stripe payment cookies (checkout)
• NEXT_LOCALE: language preference (nl/en)

sections.title: Analytics cookies
sections.body: We currently do not use third-party analytics cookies (no Google Analytics, no Facebook Pixel). If we add analytics in the future, we will ask for your consent first.

sections.title: Marketing cookies
sections.body: We do not use marketing or tracking cookies. We do not track you across other websites.

sections.title: Managing cookies
sections.body: You can block or delete cookies in your browser settings. Note: blocking essential cookies may limit website functionality (you won't be able to log in or book).

complaints.title: Complaints procedure
complaints.intro: Not satisfied? We take every complaint seriously and aim for a quick, fair resolution.

sections.title: How to file a complaint
sections.body:
Send an email to klachten@getcleaners.nl with:
• Your name and email
• The booking reference (BK-XXXXXXXX)
• A description of the complaint
• Any photos or evidence

You'll receive an acknowledgment within 2 business days.

sections.title: How we handle complaints
sections.body:
We investigate every complaint carefully. Depending on the nature:
• Quality complaint: we offer a free reclean or full refund.
• Damage: we activate the insurance (covered up to €300,000 per visit).
• Conduct complaint: we contact the cleaner and take appropriate action.

sections.title: Timeline
sections.body: We aim to resolve every complaint within 14 days. For complex cases (e.g., damage claims), we'll inform you of the expected processing time.

sections.title: Our guarantee
sections.body:
If you report a complaint within 24 hours of the clean:
• We arrange a free reclean, or
• You receive a full refund.
This guarantee applies to every booking via the Platform.

sections.title: External dispute resolution
sections.body: Can't reach an agreement? You can file a complaint with the European ODR platform (ec.europa.eu/odr) or the Dutch Consumer Disputes Committee (Geschillencommissie Thuiswinkel).

safety.title: How we build trust
safety.intro: cleaners is built as a trust platform. Letting someone into your home is personal — that's why safety isn't a feature, it's the foundation of everything we do.

sections.title: Cleaner verification
sections.body:
Every cleaner on the platform goes through a three-step verification process:

1. Identity check — passport or ID card, verified with a live selfie.
2. Background check (VOG) — a Dutch Certificate of Conduct issued by the government.
3. Reference check — at least three references from previous clients or employers.

Only after passing all three steps does a profile become visible on the platform.

sections.title: Insurance
sections.body:
Every booking through cleaners is insured up to €300,000 per visit. The insurance covers liability for property damage during the clean.

Need to report damage? Do so within 24 hours via our complaints procedure. We activate the insurer and guide you through the process.

sections.title: Escrow payment
sections.body:
You pay securely via Stripe (iDEAL, credit card, or Apple Pay). The amount is held in escrow — meaning your money is only released to the cleaner after a successful clean.

This protects you as a client: if something goes wrong, you always have recourse.

sections.title: Satisfaction guarantee
sections.body:
Not happy after the clean? Report it within 24 hours:

• We arrange a free reclean, or
• You receive a full refund.

No fine print. No arguing about who's right. We take responsibility.

sections.title: Privacy and data protection
sections.body:
We process personal data in accordance with GDPR. Your address is only shared with the booked cleaner, never with third parties. Payment data is processed by Stripe — we never store card numbers.

More details: see our privacy policy.

sections.title: Platform security
sections.body: All connections are encrypted (TLS). We use Row Level Security in our database: every user only sees their own data. We conduct regular security audits on our code and infrastructure.

sections.title: What if something goes wrong
sections.body:
We take every complaint seriously. Our complaints process:

1. Report your complaint within 24 hours via klachten@getcleaners.nl.
2. You receive an acknowledgment within 2 business days.
3. We investigate and offer a resolution within 14 days.

Can't reach an agreement? You can file with the European ODR platform or the Dutch Consumer Disputes Committee.
